description:
List review requests assigned to a demo reviewer that await a decision.

Returns status=pending requests whose assigned reviewer is reviewer_id,
oldest first (at most 200). An unknown persona is an error; a persona
with nothing pending gets an empty list.

title: List pending reviews

description:
Record a decision (approved, rejected, deferred, override) on a
pending request.

Ask the user to confirm before calling. reviewer_id must be the
persona the request is assigned to, and it must still be pending.
override replaces the proposal with the reviewer's own call and needs
corrected_parent_label and corrected_pcas; the other decisions take
neither. Every decision is final. Sandbox write only; the decision is
a demonstration, not RCDC coding.

corrected_parent_label.description: override only (required there): true = is NITRD, false = not NITRD. Omit for approved / rejected / deferred.

corrected_pcas.description: override only (required there): the reviewer's PCAs, no repeats; 1-12 when corrected_parent_label is true, [] when false. Omit for approved / rejected / deferred.

decision.description:
Decisions a reviewer can submit. All four are final.

override = the reviewer replaces the proposal with their own call: a
corrected parent label (is NITRD yes/no) and corrected Task 2 PCAs. Only
override carries corrections; they are null for the other three.

rationale.description: Why the reviewer decided this (stored with the decision).

reviewer_id.description: Fictional demo reviewer persona ID from the bundled roster, e.g. demo_po_niaid_01, demo_ic_rep_nci, demo_sia. Not a real person; no authentication.

title: Submit a review decision

description:
Submit a NITRD categorization suggestion for human review (sandbox write).

Ask the user to confirm before calling. reviewer_id is the demo persona
SUBMITTING the request; the portal chooses the assigned reviewer itself
(see portal_get_reviewer_assignment to preview). Give task1_suggestion,
task2_suggestion, or both. Writes only to sandbox tables; never changes
RCDC or any NIH record. Safe to retry: an identical request, or the same
idempotency_key with the same content, returns the existing record with
created=false. Reusing an idempotency_key with different content is an
error and writes nothing.

appl_id.description: NIH application ID (ExPORTER APPLICATION_ID) of one fiscal-year record, e.g. 10506013. Get one from outputs_find_projects.

evidence.description: What the reviewer should look at.

key_terms.description: Classifier features or scope terms cited.

anyOf.description: Optional client key (8-128 chars: letters, digits, . _ : -). A retry with the same key returns the original request. Omit to key on the payload itself.

reviewer_id.description: Fictional demo reviewer persona ID from the bundled roster, e.g. demo_po_niaid_01, demo_ic_rep_nci, demo_sia. Not a real person; no authentication.

anyOf.description: Parent (NITRD yes/no) suggestion being sent for review.
Subcategory (PCA) suggestion being sent for review.

pcas.description: Suggested PCAs, most likely first; no repeats.
